//: Furniture that holds things (06 §9.2, 16 §4.3): a chest, a cupboard, a wardrobe a person can hide in, and a market stall. Each is a cell of the grid until someone opens it, puts something in it or hides in it, when it becomes the device of `containers.json` that holds what is inside. What a map puts in one is latent until then (06 §9.3): it is made the first time the thing is opened, searched or broken. Values are illustrative.
A wardrobe holds clothes, or a person who wants not to be found.
A trader's stall: a board under an awning with goods laid out on it, to be taken.
